metadata.name: Indelible
metadata.description: Indelible is a self-hosted read-it-later and knowledge library. It stores articles, newsletters, PDFs, and EPUBs in PostgreSQL and an S3-compatible object store, and the API serves the web app on the same port.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: IND_ENV
environment_variables.description: Local trial mode. Production requires an https IND_BASE_URL and refuses plain HTTP.

environment_variables.name: DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the postgres service. The database must provide pgvector.

environment_variables.name: S3_ENDPOINT
environment_variables.description: S3-compatible endpoint for the bundled Silo service.

environment_variables.name: S3_REGION
environment_variables.description: Region sent to Silo.

environment_variables.name: S3_BUCKET
environment_variables.description: Bucket created by indelible-silo-init.

environment_variables.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY
environment_variables.description: Silo access key. Matches MINIO_ROOT_USER.

environment_variables.name: S3_SECRET_KEY
environment_variables.description: Silo secret. Matches MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.

environment_variables.name: S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
environment_variables.description: Path-style URLs, required for Silo.

environment_variables.name: AUTH_CREDENTIAL_KEY
environment_variables.description: Base64 of 32 random bytes. Must be identical on the API and worker.

environment_variables.name: EGRESS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS
environment_variables.description: Keep the SSRF guard closed. Set true only to reach an AI server on the host.

environment_variables.name: IND_HOST
environment_variables.description: API bind address.

environment_variables.name: IND_PORT
environment_variables.description: Port the published API image listens on.

environment_variables.name: IND_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Public URL of this instance for the local trial.

environment_variables.name: FRONTEND_URL
environment_variables.description: Web origin. Must match IND_BASE_URL.

environment_variables.name: CORS_ORIGINS
environment_variables.description: Origins allowed to refresh a session.

environment_variables.name: EXTENSION_REDIRECT_URIS
environment_variables.description: Browser extension identity callbacks from the v0.1.1 local compose.

environment_variables.name: JWT_SECRET
environment_variables.description: Signs session tokens.

environment_variables.name: CSRF_SECRET
environment_variables.description: CSRF secret.

environment_variables.name: ASSET_COOKIE_SECRET
environment_variables.description: 64 hex characters. Signs short-lived asset cookies.

environment_variables.name: OIDC_ENABLED
environment_variables.description: Leave false unless OIDC issuer, client id, and client secret are set.

environment_variables.name: RENDERER_HOST
environment_variables.description: Renderer bind address.

environment_variables.name: RENDERER_PORT
environment_variables.description: Renderer listen port on the compose network.

environment_variables.name: RENDERER_URL
environment_variables.description: Worker address for the renderer service.

environment_variables.name: POSTGRES_USER
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL user.

environment_variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL password. Must match DATABASE_URL.

environment_variables.name: POSTGRES_DB
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL database name.

environment_variables.name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
environment_variables.description: Silo root user.

environment_variables.name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Silo root password. Must match S3_SECRET_KEY.

before_install.en_us: Open http://localhost:38473 and create the first account. Signups close after that account exists. This is the official localhost trial: plain HTTP, not the production compose. A public hostname needs HTTPS, and production mode refuses to boot without it.
